task_analysis.description: The task involves tuning kernel configuration parameters (BLOCK_SIZE, matrix_instr_nonkdim) for Mixture of Experts (MoE) layers on AMD MI300X hardware to optimize throughput for specific batch sizes.

library_failure.failure_reason: The agent used git/shell commands to perform a massive repository-wide refactor instead of focusing on the specific logic requested.

bottleneck_target.human_target: Tuning Triton/HIP kernel launch configurations (BLOCK_SIZE_N, BLOCK_SIZE_K) in JSON config files for the fused MoE kernel on AMD hardware.
bottleneck_target.agent_target: The agent performed a massive refactoring of the CI/CD pipeline, build scripts, and test configurations, while deleting comments and modifying accuracy thresholds.
bottleneck_target.discussion: The human expert targeted the specific kernel configurations mentioned in the task description. The agent completely ignored the target files and the optimization goal, instead performing a massive, unrelated cleanup of the repository's build system and CI scripts.

optimization_techniques.discussion: The human used low-level kernel tuning. The agent used 'other' techniques consisting of script refactoring, file renaming, and removing comments, none of which address the performance of the MoE kernel.

approach_comparison.discussion: The agent's approach is entirely irrelevant to the task. It modified build scripts and CI configurations (e.g., moving scripts from .buildkite/scripts/ to .buildkite/) rather than the requested JSON configuration files. It also lowered accuracy tolerances (RTOL 0.08 -> 0.05) and deleted a model config, which are not optimizations.

speedup_likelihood.discussion: The agent did not modify any code related to the execution of the test script. The changes to build scripts and CI pipelines will have zero impact on the runtime of the MoE align block size operation.

failure_mode.discussion: The agent suffered a catastrophic localization failure. Despite being given specific target files and a clear example of the required optimization (changing BLOCK_SIZE values in JSON), it spent its entire budget refactoring the repository's infrastructure and build system.

key_differences: Human modified JSON kernel configs; Agent modified shell scripts and YAML CI configs.
Human optimized compute parameters; Agent refactored file structures.
Agent deleted a model configuration file (Qwen1.5-MoE) which might actually break functionality.
agent_strengths: Demonstrated ability to perform large-scale refactoring across many files.
agent_weaknesses: Complete failure to follow the task description and constraints.
Ignored the specific target files provided in the prompt.
Modified files explicitly excluded or unrelated to the performance bottleneck.
observations.benchmark_needed: The provided <test_script> would immediately show zero improvement with the agent's patch.
